mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quotation.transport_request (id, request_number, shipper_company_id, status, current_version_no, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestNumber}, #{shipperCompanyId}, #{status}, #{currentVersionNo}, #{version})

INSERT INTO quotation.transport_request_version (transport_request_id, version_no, consignee_company_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, cargo_category, package_type, package_count, gross_weight_kg, volume_m3, submitted_by, submitted_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{currentVersionNo}, #{consigneeCompanyId}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{arrivalDeadline}, #{cargoCategory}, #{packageType}, #{packageCount}, #{grossWeightKg}, #{volumeM3}, #{submittedBy}, #{submittedAt})

INSERT INTO quotation.transport_request_version (transport_request_id, version_no, consignee_company_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, cargo_category, package_type, package_count, gross_weight_kg, volume_m3, submitted_by, submitted_at) SELECT #{id}, #{currentVersionNo}, #{consigneeCompanyId}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{arrivalDeadline}, #{cargoCategory}, #{packageType}, #{packageCount}, #{grossWeightKg}, #{volumeM3}, #{submittedBy}, #{submittedAt} WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quotation.transport_request_version WHERE transport_request_id = #{id} AND version_no = #{currentVersionNo})

INSERT INTO quotation.review_record (id, transport_request_id, version_no, decision, reviewer_id, rationale, missing_items, decided_at) SELECT #{id}, #{transportRequestId}, #{versionNo}, #{decision}, #{reviewerId}, #{rationale}, #{missingItems}, #{decidedAt} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quotation.review_record WHERE id = #{id})
mapper.select: SELECT id, transport_request_id, version_no, decision, reviewer_id, rationale, missing_items, decided_at FROM quotation.review_record WHERE transport_request_id = #{transportRequestId} ORDER BY version_no, decided_at, id
mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.request_number, r.shipper_company_id, r.status, r.current_version_no, r.version, v.consignee_company_id, v.origin_unlocode, v.destination_unlocode, v.arrival_deadline, v.cargo_category, v.package_type, v.package_count, v.gross_weight_kg, v.volume_m3, v.submitted_by, v.submitted_at FROM quotation.transport_request r JOIN quotation.transport_request_version v ON v.transport_request_id = r.id AND v.version_no = r.current_version_no

SELECT r.request_number, r.current_version_no, r.status, first_version.submitted_at AS first_submitted_at, v.submitted_at AS current_submitted_at, v.origin_unlocode, v.destination_unlocode, v.arrival_deadline, v.cargo_category FROM quotation.transport_request r JOIN quotation.transport_request_version v ON v.transport_request_id = r.id AND v.version_no = r.current_version_no JOIN quotation.transport_request_version first_version ON first_version.transport_request_id = r.id AND first_version.version_no = 1
mapper.select: WHERE r.status = 'UNDER_REVIEW' ORDER BY first_version.submitted_at, r.request_number
WHERE r.shipper_company_id = #{shipperCompanyId} ORDER BY first_version.submitted_at DESC, r.request_number DESC
